newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Russian officer shot dead in Tajik capital.
newsitem.headline: Russian officer shot dead in Tajik capital.

text.p: A Russian officer was shot dead by an unidentified gunman on Friday in the former Soviet republic of Tajikistan, the Russian military said.

Lieutenant-Colonel Vladimir Bachin, of Russia's 201st Motorised Infantry Division, was shot five times in the back with a pistol in the western part of the Tajik capital Dushanbe, a spokesman for the mainly Russian peacekeeping force in the civil war-torn country told Reuters.
"There are certain destructive forces which are trying to destabilise the situation in Tajikistan," the peacekeeping force said in a statement.
About 20,000 Russian soldiers carry out peacekeeping duties in the republic, torn apart by four years of domestic conflict, and guard its remote, mountainous border with Afghanistan.
Dozens of Russian servicemen have been killed and wounded in similar incidents. Russian soldiers and their families are driven to and from work accompanied by armed escorts.
